CREATE TABLE week_goal ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, when_started TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, when_ended TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, completeness INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT fk_week_goal_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_week_goal_user ON week_goal (user_id); CREATE INDEX idx_week_goal_range ON week_goal (when_started, when_ended);
